name: json_schema
description: JSON Schema validation and default-value enrichment in SQL. Validate that JSON columns conform to a schema, lint the schema itself, generate JSON-Patch operations that fill in missing defaults, and apply those defaults in place. Built on the [pboettch/json-schema-validator](https://github.com/pboettch/json-schema-validator) C++ library — primary target is JSON Schema draft-07.

cta.title: Validate JSON in SQL
cta.description: Install JSON Schema to enforce data contracts on JSON columns at query time — useful for API ingest checks, ETL data-quality gates, and config validation.
